summary: Phase S3 routing of finding dispositions has six verified defects: an incomplete routing loop, an ambiguous keep rule, missing route parity in two audit roles, a missing user decision point in new-track step 9, a severity scale conflict between review.md and contracts.md, and a checker copy divergence in the host install path. The dispositions line format and checker regex are consistent.

contract_applicability.basis: Phase S3 changes the inter-role routing contract: finding ids, dispositions line, re-review rounds, and user escalation. These define the flow between the Green role, audit roles, the orchestrator, and the user, so the endpoint and flow contract applies.

blocking_findings: F1 [Major] review-c: The routing loop has no rule for a round that contains only CONTEST items. skills/measure/references/spec-review.md:69 runs a second round only when spec.md or plan.md changed. skills/measure/references/new-track.md:312-313 sends CONTEST items to the raiser but does not state the outcome when no file changes.

F2 [Major] review-c: The keep-and-withdraw paragraph in five audit roles ends with "in your earlier list." This wording does not define a fresh re-review. The affected files are agents/measure-review-a-correctness.md:61-63, agents/measure-review-b-security.md:61-63, agents/measure-review-c-ux-api.md:54-56, agents/measure-phase-acceptance.md:72-74, and agents/measure-spec-review.md:77-79.

F3 [Major] review-c: agents/measure-adversarial-testing.md and agents/measure-ux-browser-review.md contain no CONTEST, withdraw, dispositions, routed-finding, or retry_recommendation text. skills/measure-orchestrator/references/contracts.md:92 lists both scopes as routed finding sources, so route parity is missing.

F4 [Major] review-c: skills/measure/references/new-track.md step 9 has no user decision point for ESCALATE items and for CONTEST items kept after re-review. skills/measure-orchestrator/SKILL.md:145-146 assigns these items to the user, so the flow does not match the orchestrator contract.

F5 [Major] review-c: skills/measure/references/review.md:196 allows DECLINE only for a Low finding, and review.md:170 uses the scale Critical, High, Medium, Low. skills/measure-orchestrator/references/contracts.md:92-99 allows DECLINE only for a Nit finding in contracts.md and spec-review.md, and uses the scale Blocker, Major, Nit. The two documents conflict on the severity scale for DECLINE.

F6 [Major] review-c: The checker copy at ~/.agents/skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py has no dispositions_feedback function and no DISPOSITIONS regex. The repo copy at skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:83-84, 418, and 630 has both. measure/tracks/spec_review_gate_20261030/plan.md cites the ~/.agents path as the validator, so the enforcement check does not run from that path.
nonblocking_findings: F7 [Nit] review-c: skills/measure-orchestrator/references/contracts.md:85-124 has no worked example of the dispositions line. agents/measure-jr-green.md:34-48 contains one example, so the contract reference lacks a reference example.

F8 [Nit] review-c: contracts.md uses both "required" and "optional" wording for the dispositions line when routed findings are absent. The Green role file requires the line only when routed findings exist. Use one term for one meaning.

F9 [Nit] review-c: The re-review wording in skills/measure/references/spec-review.md and in contracts.md does not state whether a same-HEAD re-review and a new-HEAD re-review differ. State the rule once in contracts.md.
